description: Low red blood cells or hemoglobin, causing fatigue, pale skin and shortness of breath.
patient_advice: Check iron, vitamin B12, and discuss dietary/iron supplementation with doctor.

description: Elevated white blood cell count typically indicating an active bacterial/viral infection or inflammation.
patient_advice: Identify source of infection and consult physician for appropriate treatment.

description: Low blood platelet count increasing the tendency to bruise or bleed.
patient_advice: Carefully monitor for bleeding spots, avoid blood-thinning NSAIDs, consult doctor urgently if platelets < 50,000.

description: Elevated blood sugar level above normal physiological thresholds.
patient_advice: Follow diabetic meal plan, stay active, monitor fasting/PPBS, and adjust medication with doctor.

description: Elevated cholesterol or triglycerides in bloodstream.
patient_advice: Adopt heart-healthy low-oil diet, increase cardiovascular exercise, and follow lipid-lowering advice.
